Home > How To Apply HOW TO APPLY GMIU ADMISSION STEPS 01 Visit Website Open www.gmiu.edu.in . You will see the main homepage of the university. 02 Admission 2026-27 Click on Admission 2026-27 , then scroll and click on Register/Login link. 03 Register / Login Login with mobile & password or register by filling your details to create account. 04 Select Faculty Select your faculty. (Choose GGC if applying for the Girls' College specifically.) 05 Course Level Select the level of course from the dropdown: Diploma, UG, or PG . 06 Learning Method Select the method: PLM (Proficient Learning Method) or Regular . 07 Select Program Choose the specific program you want to pursue. 08 Payment Mode Choose payment mode: Online, Offline, or EMI . (If EMI, select EMI mode: online/offline.) 09 Assistance Details Select who assisted you for admission and enter Referral Number if applicable. 10 Admission Year Select admission year from the dropdown (Example: 2026-27 Regular ). 11 Select District Select your Home District from the dropdown to complete location details. 12 Pay & Confirm Click Pay Now , complete payment and download your Admission Fee Receipt . content: IEP Program at Gyanmanjari Innovative University | GMIU IEP Home IEP International Experience Program (IEP) CGBS has been established to promote Internationalization efforts of the University i.e. hosting foreign delegations, organizing International Conferences, mentoring foreign students who are studying at GTU, promoting research and study of international trade among management students under GCSR (Global Country Study Report) program. GTU is having the largest International Experience Program. International Experience Program is an important component of GTU's international program consisting of Joint research and exchange of students and faculty members. GTU has signed the MOU with renowned universities of Canada, Germany, USA, Russia, Poland, New Zealand, China, UK, Taiwan, Bhutan, South Africa, Netherlands and Slovenia. GTU arranges the International Experience Program (IEP) for its students for several countries since 2011 where the students visit universities, which are GTU's foreign partners, in the semester gap and study two (Pre decided) subjects of their respective courses. GTU is sending students to Canada, USA, Russia and Germany under this program in the month of June and July every year since 2011. More than 1100 students from various branches of Management, Engineering and Pharmacy have participated in International Experience Program (IEP) till date from 2011.
